purpose: Apply the 4-Mar IJN air-unit structural reorganization without duplicating the same G4M/Zeros in western and Central-Pacific ledgers.

705_to_K706_G4M.historical_structure_anchor: On 4 Mar the 705th NAG land-attack flight element became Attack Squadron K-706 under 755th NAG.
705_to_K706_G4M.04Mar_accounting: All coherent G4M combat credit transfers administratively to K706. The 13-aircraft western residual from the 3-Mar transit snapshot is not retained as a second western G4M strike group.

K706_08Mar.note: Ferry/reorganization/ground-echelon lag prevents all assigned aircraft from becoming immediate sorties. No west-area sortie credit from these same aircraft.

705_western_residual_after_reorganizatio.aircraft_type_center: B5N carrier attack aircraft with at most token B6N/other local airframes; not G4M long-range bombers.
705_western_residual_after_reorganizatio.range_guard: This is a local Sumatra/Andaman-Sea tool. It cannot inherit the former G4M deep-Bay search/strike radius.

331_to_S603_202NAG.historical_structure_anchor: Effective 4 Mar, the original 331st fighter element was reorganized as S-603 under 202nd NAG; historical source gives 33 Zeros and movement toward Davao by mid-March.
331_to_S603_202NAG.08Mar_state: FERRY_REDEPLOYMENT_IN_PROGRESS; no coherent first-line 331/S603 fighter squadron remains available for Bay offensive escort.

western_straggler_or_maintenance_credit.guard: Not a formed strike escort unit.

331_to_S603_202NAG.new_331: NOT_YET_AVAILABLE. Historical new-unit authorization/formation is mid-March and cannot be backfilled on 4-8 Mar.

Tokai_MAD: Western dedicated ASW detachment remains separate and active; no confirmed Allied submarine datum produces a kill in this window.
Eastern_Fleet_effect: By 8 Mar the Japanese west-area naval-air system is substantially worse at wide-area deep-Bay search and escorted long-range attack than it was in mid-February. This is a major reason INITIAL does not trigger an automatic air response.
